name: Glassbone, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 3, cleric 4, inquisitor 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, spiritualist 4, witch 4
Targets one living creature/2 levels (no two of which may be more than 30 feet apart)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as glassbone except it affects multiple creatures within range.
